scope: M146 four-bank FIFO-age scheduler RTL, sealed VCS/DC evidence, independent VCS stress and independent same-flow DC reproduction

independent_dc.critical_cone: 32-bit correction completion identity equality and quarantine/state update

findings.title: 32-bit identity has an undocumented ABA window after full wrap
findings.evidence: Age order is FIFO-based and remains correct across wrap, but completion acceptance uses only bank, tag and the reused 32-bit sequence. After 2^32 accepted fills, an ancient response with the same bank/tag/sequence is indistinguishable from the current response.
findings.impact: The broad fail-closed stale-response-rejection statement is not unconditional without a response-lifetime bound or an additional non-wrapping epoch.
findings.required_action: Before admission, state and assert a maximum response lifetime strictly below the identity reuse interval, or widen/add an epoch that cannot alias while a stale response can remain in flight. Add a direct contract caveat.

findings.title: release_valid is not masked by synchronous reset
findings.evidence: Independent VCS drove a matching correction completion while rst_core was high before the reset edge and observed release_valid=1 exactly once. Other issue/ready/error outputs are reset-gated, but release_valid is not.
findings.impact: A downstream block that expects no transaction while reset is asserted can consume a phantom release; default-disable SVA does not see it.
findings.required_action: Gate release_valid with !rst_core and add an assertion that all transaction valids are low during reset.

findings.title: Production directed VCS leaves important protocol partitions implicit
findings.evidence: The sealed test attacks sequence and bank reuse but does not separately close wrong-bank, wrong-tag, wrap-order, both FIFO-full states, midflight reset, and reset-output quietness. The independent test closes these except the 2^32 ABA lifetime itself.
findings.impact: The current sealed receipt is reproducible but its coverage counters overstate breadth if read as full protocol closure.
findings.required_action: Port the independent cases or equivalent exact-SHA tests into the production regression and report each partition separately.

findings.title: Sealed DC receipt parser emitted a blank critical path value
findings.evidence: The frozen QoR report says 0.90 ns, while RUN_COMPLETE.txt is blank because the runner selected awk field 5 instead of field 4. The frozen correction overlay is identity-pinned and correct.
findings.impact: The overlay preserves evidence integrity, but the original runner is not self-consistent for a clean rerun/seal workflow.
findings.required_action: Fix the runner parser in the next revision, add a non-empty numeric validation, and reseal rather than editing this sealed run.

findings.title: Evidence remains standalone pre-macro logic-only DC
findings.evidence: The result uses ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macros; no RTL-to-netlist Formality or physical implementation is included. The independent rerun exactly reproduces this stated scope.
findings.impact: Area and timing are useful module evidence but not paper PPA, drop-in M142 equivalence or a speedup result.
findings.required_action: If promoted beyond structural evidence, add matched integration, Formality, physical timing and an executable same-workload cycle comparison.

validated_strengths: Two four-entry bank-ID ring FIFOs preserve insertion age without any sequence less-than/greater-than comparator.
Both FIFO-full states, repeated bank reuse, simultaneous push/pop handoffs and 32-bit wrap-order behavior pass independent VCS.
Wrong bank, wrong tag, wrong sequence and unsolicited duplicate completions enter sticky fail-closed quarantine.
Sealed VCS and DC identities verify, and independent Synopsys reruns reproduce their functional and synthesis metrics.
Existing contracts correctly prohibit M142 drop-in equivalence, physical/system speedup and headline use.
review_disposition: Keep M146 as a credible comparator-free standalone scheduler mechanism. Do not admit unconditional stale-response rejection or any 2.8x/3.78x speedup wording. Repair H01 and H02, roll the independent protocol partitions into the sealed regression, then re-review.
